assumptions.statement: SITE_BOUNDARY and three KEY_AREA polygons are provisional_constraint features from brief/site-package/geometry/provisional_boundaries.geojson; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All area ratios and spatial structure diagrams are intake-grade and must be recalculated when official polygons are published. Organizer data gap does not block content scoring.

assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, cultural-heritage buffers, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: FAR, building height, setbacks, demolition decisions, and utility alignments remain unknown or conceptual and are not claimed as approved controls.

assumptions.statement: AI scenario cards, activity systems, and brand identity are operational concept suggestions for professional deepening, not committed government programs or funded events.
assumptions.impact: Operational KPIs require future data partnerships and human governance before deployment.

assumptions.statement: Text, geometry, diagrams, PDFs, and static HTML are agent-generated from public/cleared repository materials listed in sources.json; no remote assets are required at review time.
assumptions.impact: Any third-party fonts/logos/trademarks used in future marketing must be separately cleared.
